goalZh: 会听登机口广播里的换登机口、晚点和按组登机,没听清时会确认
canDoZh: 能听懂登机口的广播(换登机口、延误、按组登机),没听清时会找工作人员确认

newItems.noteZh: 广播开头的固定说法;重音在 -TEN-,tion 读 /ʃən/。
重音在前 PAS-sen-ger,g 读 /dʒ/;广播里常说 Passengers to Los Angeles…(去洛杉矶的旅客……)
a gate change(登机口变更);也能当动词“改、换”;ch 读 /tʃ/,结尾 ge 读 /dʒ/。
重音在 -NOUNCE-,ou 读 /aʊ/;an announcement for our flight(我们航班的广播)。
noise(噪音)+ y,s 读 /z/;It's so noisy here!(这儿太吵了!)
What number?(几号?)u 读 /ʌ/;第 1 单元学过 phone number(电话号码)。
Can you repeat that, please?(请您再说一遍好吗?)和第 1 单元的 Could you say that again? 意思一样;重音在后 re-PEAT。
The announcement isn't clear.(广播听不清楚。)cl 连读,ear 读 /ɪr/,要卷舌。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Attention, please. There's a gate change for Flight 207.
lines.zh: (B12 登机口,广播)各位旅客请注意,207 航班更换登机口。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Passengers to Los Angeles, please go to Gate B15.
lines.zh: 前往洛杉矶的旅客,请到 B15 登机口。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Was that an announcement for our flight? It's so noisy!
lines.zh: 那是我们航班的广播吗?这儿太吵了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes, a gate change. But the number isn't clear. B15 or B50?
lines.zh: 是,换登机口了。可是没听清是几号。B15 还是 B50?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Excuse me. Is our flight at Gate B15 or B50?
lines.zh: (磊去问工作人员)打扰一下。我们的航班是在 B15 还是 B50 登机?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: B15. One, five. And the flight is delayed twenty minutes.
lines.zh: B15,一、五。还有,航班晚点二十分钟。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sorry? Can you repeat that, please?
lines.zh: 不好意思?您能再说一遍吗?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Sure. Twenty minutes late. We board at 6:55.
lines.zh: 好的。晚二十分钟,6:55 登机。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Now boarding Group 1. Group 1 only, please.
lines.zh: (B15 登机口)现在请第 1 组登机。只限第 1 组。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.zh: 我们是第 3 组。在这儿等吧。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Now boarding Group 3. Thank you for waiting.
lines.zh: 现在请第 3 组登机。感谢您的耐心等待。

options: 207 航班换到 B15 登机口
questions.explainZh: There's a gate change for Flight 207. …… please go to Gate B15.

questions.prompt: 工作人员说航班怎么了?
questions.explainZh: And the flight is delayed twenty minutes.(所以 6:55 才登机。)

questions.prompt: 磊和索菲亚是第几组登机?

grammar.bodyZh: Attention, please.(请注意。)There's a gate change.(登机口有变更。)Now boarding Group 1.(现在请第 1 组登机。)The flight is delayed twenty minutes.(航班晚点二十分钟。)Thank you for waiting.(感谢您的耐心等待。)没听清时:Sorry? Can you repeat that, please?(第 1 单元的 Could you say that again? 也可以)。字母 B、D、E、G 读音很像;数字 15(fif-TEEN,重音在后)和 50(FIF-ty,重音在前)也容易听错,不确定就问一句 B15 or B50?。
